verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a legal-services platform for founders, so a library of standard legal templates is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers notarization of uploaded documents, incorporation, translation, apostilles and tax/trade registration, but never mentions vetted templates for NDAs, agreements or policies. Users upload their own documents rather than starting from a provided library.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents
